```{r load-packages, include=FALSE}
pacs <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "rentrez", "XML")
sapply(pacs, require, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r fetch-pubmed}

# Read publication list ---------------------------------------------------

pub_list <- read_excel("oda_keiji_publications.xlsx") %>%
  setNames(c("listid", "year", "authors", "pubmedid"))

# Fetch from PubMed -------------------------------------------------------

records <- entrez_fetch(
  db      = "pubmed",
  id      = pub_list$pubmedid,
  rettype = "xml",
  parsed  = TRUE
)
```

```{r parse-xml}

# Parse XML ---------------------------------------------------------------

abbreviate_forenames <- function(author_string) {
  authors <- strsplit(author_string, ", ")[[1]]
  abbreviated <- sapply(authors, function(a) {
    parts <- strsplit(a, " ")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) < 2) return(a)
    last     <- parts[1]
    initials <- paste(substr(parts[-1], 1, 1), collapse = "")
    paste0(last, " ", initials)
  })
  paste(abbreviated, collapse = ", ")
}

safe <- function(x, fallback = NA_character_) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.null(x)) fallback else x[1]
}

articles <- xpathApply(records, "//PubmedArticle", function(node) {
  last    <- xpathSApply(node, ".//Author/LastName", xmlValue)
  fore    <- xpathSApply(node, ".//Author/ForeName", xmlValue)
  authors <- if (length(last) > 0) paste(paste(last, fore), collapse = ", ") else NA_character_

  doi <- safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//ELocationID[@EIdType='doi']", xmlValue))
  if (is.na(doi)) {
    doi <- safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//ArticleId[@IdType='doi']", xmlValue))
  }

  data.frame(
    pmid    = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//PMID", xmlValue)),
    year    = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//PubDate/Year", xmlValue)),
    authors = authors,
    title   = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//ArticleTitle", xmlValue)),
    journal = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//Journal/Title", xmlValue)),
    volume  = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//JournalIssue/Volume", xmlValue)),
    issue   = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//JournalIssue/Issue", xmlValue)),
    pages   = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//MedlinePgn", xmlValue)),
    doi     = doi,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

pub_df <- bind_rows(articles) %>%
  arrange(desc(year))

```

```{r clean-data}

# Clean up ----------------------------------------------------------------

pub_df$authors <- sapply(pub_df$authors, abbreviate_forenames)
pub_df$journal <- gsub("^[Tt]he\\s+", "", pub_df$journal)
pub_df$journal <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(pub_df$journal))
pub_df$journal <- gsub("Journal of Prevention \\(2022\\)", "Journal of Prevention", pub_df$journal)

# Manual correction
doi_corrections <- data.frame(
  pmid = c("23139343"),
  doi  = c("10.7556/jaoa.2012.112.11.726"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

pub_df <- pub_df %>%
  left_join(doi_corrections, by = "pmid", suffix = c("", "_manual")) %>%
  mutate(doi = ifelse(is.na(doi) & !is.na(doi_manual), doi_manual, doi)) %>%
  select(-doi_manual)

pub_df$journal <- gsub("\\s*:.*$", "", pub_df$journal)

```

```{r build-markdown, results='asis'}

# Build citations ---------------------------------------------------------

make_md_citation <- function(row) {
  row <- as.list(row)

  # Format volume/issue/pages
  volissue <- if (!is.na(row$volume)) row$volume else ""
  volissue <- if (!is.na(row$issue))  paste0(volissue, "(", row$issue, ")") else volissue
  pages    <- if (!is.na(row$pages))  paste0(":", row$pages) else ""

  # DOI or PubMed link (Markdown hyperlink)
  link <- if (!is.na(row$doi)) {
    sprintf("[[DOI]](https://doi.org/%s)", row$doi)
  } else {
    sprintf("[[PubMed]](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/%s/)", row$pmid)
  }

  # Bold my name 
  authors_md <- gsub("Oda K\\b", "**Oda K**", row$authors, perl = TRUE)

  sprintf(
    "%s (%s). *%s* **%s** %s%s %s",
    authors_md,
    row$year,
    row$title,
    row$journal,
    volissue,
    pages,
    link
  )
}

citations <- apply(pub_df, 1, make_md_citation)

# Descending count embedded in text (GFM ignores actual list numbers,
# so we use an unordered list and prepend the number manually)
n <- length(citations)
for (i in seq_along(citations)) {
  cat(sprintf("- [%d] %s\n\n", n - i + 1, citations[i]))
}
```
